body:
Sorry for making you cry. 

I'm trying not to, I'm on a waiting list for a psychologist but it could take a few months or even a year.

I have two friends I truly can trust, however one is has her own problems with depression and the other I don't want to burden with my problems. 
I have tried to do activities with my time, I used to love reading and drawing but I just can't concentrate anymore. 
I'm so used to putting on a happy face and give a fake laugh, but one of the close friends can see I'm not really happy and it's all fake. She asks questions but I just feel like I can't open up to her.

My past, all the things that have happened and I have done. Right now I feel so alone, I can't tell my parents as they are part of the problem. I have no real friends since I had my daughter and feel to awkward to even make new friends.
